target_variant: European Portuguese appropriate to Cabo Verde
intent: Supplies the single governed EN/PT label for the independent contextual-return link on every published Things-to-Do detail page, directing visitors to the Things to Do section on the same-locale Home page. Strictly additive: introduces one new key, reuses or overwrites nothing (in particular not things.shared.back_to_things, which names the unpublished collection hub and its dormant breadcrumb), and alters no lifecycle, publication, currentness, canonical or hreflang policy.

rows.source_en: Go to Things to Do on the homepage
rows.pt: Ir para O que fazer na página inicial
rows.context_notes: Visible text and accessible name of the independent contextual-return link on every Things-to-Do detail page. EN targets /#things-to-do, PT targets /pt/#things-to-do. Independent of the unpublished collection hub and its dormant breadcrumb (things.shared.back_to_things), which this key must never replace. No aria-label: the visible text is the accessible name.
rows.linguistic_notes: Final Project 09 wording, carried verbatim. "O que fazer" is the established governed Portuguese name of the Things to Do section. Carries no protected brand string and no placeholder.
